audit.process: release of piloto (Python CLI published on PyPI)
audit.scope: fixtures/repos/python-cli/repo/: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, src/piloto/AGENTS.md, .claude/skills/release, .github/workflows, ruff.toml, .pre-commit-config.yaml, pyproject.toml, tests/, .harness/

elements.finding: The skill mixes judgment, procedure, script paths (one of which does not exist), an L4 trigger through git push --tags with no stopping point, and a PyPI token in clear text that contradicts the ban on publishing outside release.yml.
elements.target: Pure procedure: release plan (dry-run), bump PR, release tag on the merged commit, reading the URL and the exit code of the release.yml run; steps 6 and 7 removed.
elements.check: No occurrence of PYPI_TOKEN or pypi- in the skill; every path cited exists; release plan patch runs without an agent and without writing.

elements.finding: PyPI publication from a workstation with a long-lived token, with no protected environment and no OIDC: a back door around the rule "publish only through release.yml".
elements.target: Removed; a failure of release.yml is handled by a fix and a workflow_dispatch in the pypi environment, never by a manual publication; PyPI API tokens revoked.
elements.check: File absent; grep twine over .claude and AGENTS.md empty; no active API token on the PyPI project.

elements.finding: Two incident-backed rules told without a guardrail (CHANGELOG, network), a claimed guardrail that does not run in the pipeline (mypy in pre-commit), a noise rule (docstring), two definitions of "done" and a "Run" entry that names a skill instead of a command.
elements.target: Every "Enforced by" cites a job of ci.yml or release.yml: types job (mypy), changelog PR gate, ruff banned-api rule on subprocess; line 22 removed, lines 21 and 32 merged, line 13 pointing to the CLI command.
elements.check: No "(unverified)" left in the file and every guardrail cited is run by ci.yml or release.yml.

elements.finding: The folder file allows the direct ssh subprocess that the root forbids (incident #38) and exempts cli.py from tests by relying on an E2E test that is never run; cli.py:36 already breaks the rule.
elements.target: Removed or reduced to a pointer to AGENTS.md; the network rule becomes a ruff banned-api rule (TID251) on subprocess outside net.py; cli.py:36 migrated to piloto.net as a separate task.
elements.check: File absent or with no contradicting rule; ruff check . fails on import subprocess in cli.py as long as the migration is not done.

elements.finding: Mandatory L3 logic (computing and writing the version, commit) with no test, no dry-run, no check for a clean tree or an existing tag; git commit -am takes everything along; regex duplicated with test_version_single_source; called under a wrong path.
elements.target: Tested subcommand release plan|bump|tag (tomllib, clean tree, on main, tag absent, changelog section present, --dry-run) in src/ with tests in tests/, then removal of the script.
elements.check: Tests of plan/bump/failures green in ci.yml; release plan patch writes nothing and exits 0; script removed.

elements.finding: Correct OIDC publication but with no precondition at all: no tests, no tag/version consistency, no changelog, no structured confirmation, no workflow_dispatch to replay; the preconditions told in SKILL.md must move down here.
elements.target: A verify job (ruff, mypy, pytest, tag == pyproject version, non-empty ## <version> section) in the needs of publish; a confirmation step against PyPI's JSON API; workflow_dispatch with tag and dry_run; pypi environment with required reviewers.
elements.check: A v9.9.9 tag on a commit at 1.4.2 makes verify fail without reaching publish; the run exposes version and URL as outputs.

elements.finding: Presented as the guardrail of the mypy strict rule (incident #23), the hook is local and opt-in; ci.yml never runs mypy, so nothing in the pipeline enforces the rule.
elements.target: Keep the hook, add the types job (uv run mypy src) to ci.yml.
elements.check: An untyped PR in src/piloto/ is red in CI without pre-commit installed.

elements.finding: The only test of cli.py, deselected by addopts and run nowhere (not in CI, not in the release, not in the skill), although src/piloto/AGENTS.md relies on it; addopts -x --maxfail=1 also hides the failures that follow.
elements.target: An e2e job in ci.yml with an sshd service and pytest -m slow, or a dated removal; drop -x --maxfail=1 from addopts.
elements.check: The CI log shows 1 passed for test_push_against_local_sshd, or the file is absent; addopts without -x.
The file remains a single include line.

elements.finding: Pointer to AGENTS.md with no rule of its own.
elements.check: No rule is added to it.

elements.finding: Command reference loaded on demand, consistent with pyproject.toml.
Lint and tests on PRs and main; the home of the types, e2e and changelog jobs recommended elsewhere.
elements.target: Structure unchanged, jobs added by remediations 2, 3, 6, 7.
elements.check: The lint and tests jobs remain required on PRs.

elements.finding: Selection E, F, I, B run in CI; will host the banned-api rule on subprocess.
elements.check: ruff check . is still run by ci.yml.

elements.finding: Single source of the version and mypy strict config; only addopts needs lightening, handled with test-push-e2e.
elements.check: A single version line; [tool.mypy] strict kept.

elements.finding: Real guardrail of an incident-backed rule (#31), run in CI.
elements.target: Unchanged; a model for the network rule.
elements.check: Still collected by uv run pytest.

elements.finding: Bounds DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, run in CI; does not cover the subprocess of cli.py.
elements.check: Still collected by uv run pytest.

elements.finding: Signal S1 (explicit timeout, never a bare ssh subprocess) produced the rule AGENTS.md:23 but related_rule stayed null, no guardrail followed and cli.py:36 still breaks the rule; six S5 mark rules with no incident, among them the docstring rule.
elements.target: Link S1 to the rule, close it when the ruff rule exists; write .harness/audit.json from this report.
elements.check: harness status shows the network rule as guarded.

process_leaks.rule: main must be green before releasing
process_leaks.if_skipped: A tag set on a red commit publishes to PyPI, irreversible.
process_leaks.guard_tool: verify job (ruff, mypy, pytest) in the needs of publish in release.yml

process_leaks.rule: The tag v<x> matches the version of pyproject.toml
process_leaks.if_skipped: The path scripts/bump_version.py does not exist: git tag v (empty) or a shifted tag; release.yml publishes anyway (v*).
process_leaks.guard_tool: verify step in release.yml comparing GITHUB_REF_NAME with the pyproject version; release tag subcommand

process_leaks.rule: CHANGELOG.md has a non-empty section for the published version
process_leaks.if_skipped: A new release with an empty changelog, like 1.4 (CHANGELOG.md:9 still empty).
process_leaks.guard_tool: verify job in release.yml (non-empty ## <version> section) and changelog PR gate in ci.yml with an exemption label

process_leaks.rule: Publish to PyPI only through release.yml on a tag
process_leaks.if_skipped: SKILL.md:13 and publish.sh publish from a workstation with a long-lived token, outside any audit and outside the protected environment.
process_leaks.guard_tool: removal of publish.sh; trusted publisher only on the PyPI side; pypi environment with required reviewers

process_leaks.rule: The published version is confirmed on PyPI
process_leaks.if_skipped: Hallucinated success if the publication failed: a human reading a web page.
process_leaks.guard_tool: final step of release.yml querying https://pypi.org/pypi/piloto/<version>/json with exit 1

process_leaks.rule: All code is typed and passes mypy in strict mode
process_leaks.if_skipped: The pre-commit hook is local and opt-in; ci.yml does not run mypy: an untyped PR goes green (incident #23 reproducible).
process_leaks.guard_tool: types job (uv run mypy src) in ci.yml

process_leaks.rule: Network calls go through piloto.net, never through a direct subprocess
process_leaks.if_skipped: ssh without a timeout blocks CI or the workstation (#38); cli.py:36 already does it and src/piloto/AGENTS.md:5 allows it.
process_leaks.guard_tool: ruff flake8-tidy-imports banned-api (TID251) on subprocess with per-file-ignores for src/piloto/net.py, or a test mirroring test_version_single_source.py

process_leaks.rule: Pushing to main without a PR is forbidden; the release commit must reach main
process_leaks.if_skipped: SKILL.md:10-12 commits locally on main and pushes only the tags: a tag on a commit absent from main, main without the bump.
process_leaks.guard_tool: branch protection on main; bump through a PR; tag set on the merged commit by release tag

process_leaks.rule: cli.py is covered by the E2E tests of the release
process_leaks.if_skipped: tests/test_push_e2e.py is deselected by pyproject.toml:17 and run nowhere: cli.py has no test.
process_leaks.guard_tool: e2e job in ci.yml with an sshd service and pytest -m slow

guarded_rules.rule: The version exists in one place only, pyproject.toml
A task is done when pytest passes
Publication goes through OIDC in an environment, with no stored secret
guarded_rules.guarded_by: .github/workflows/release.yml:5-7,11 (protection rules of the environment not visible)

guarded_rules.rule: The default network timeout is bounded

remediation.action: Revoke the PyPI token on pypi.org, remove line 13 of SKILL.md and .claude/skills/release/scripts/publish.sh, check that the PyPI project has only the trusted publisher.
remediation.check: grep of pypi- and twine over .claude and AGENTS.md empty; no active API token on PyPI.

remediation.action: Add the verify job (ruff, mypy, pytest, tag == version, changelog section) in the needs of publish, a confirmation step against PyPI's JSON API, workflow_dispatch with tag and dry_run; confirm the required reviewers on the pypi environment.
remediation.check: An inconsistent tag turns the run red before publish; the job output carries version and URL.

remediation.action: Add the types job (uv run mypy src) to ci.yml while keeping the local hook.
remediation.check: An untyped PR is red in CI without pre-commit installed.

remediation.action: Create the tested subcommand release plan|bump|tag (tomllib, clean tree, tag absent, changelog section, --dry-run) with its tests in tests/, then remove the script.
remediation.check: Tests green in ci.yml; release plan patch writes nothing; script absent.

remediation.action: Remove the file or reduce it to a pointer; add to ruff.toml the banned-api rule on subprocess with an exemption for net.py; open a task to migrate cli.py:36 to piloto.net.
remediation.check: ruff check . reports cli.py:5 as long as the migration is not done; file absent.

remediation.action: Add the e2e job to ci.yml with an sshd service and pytest -m slow, or remove the test with a dated comment; drop -x --maxfail=1 from pyproject.toml.
remediation.check: CI log with 1 passed for the test, or file absent; addopts without -x.

remediation.action: Add the changelog job (PR gate with an exemption label) to ci.yml; rewrite lines 13, 18, 20, 23, merge 21 into 32, remove or reduce 22.
remediation.check: No "(unverified)" left; every "Enforced by" cites a job of ci.yml or release.yml.

remediation.action: Rewrite the skill as a pure procedure around release plan, bump PR, release tag and reading the run; fix every path; remove steps 6 and 7.
remediation.check: Every command cited exists; dry run without an agent; no secret.

remediation.action: Link signal S1 to the rule AGENTS.md:23 and close it when the ruff rule exists; write .harness/audit.json from this report.
remediation.check: harness status shows the network rule as guarded.

unverified: Protection rules of the GitHub pypi environment (required reviewers) and branch protection of main: outside the repository.
On the PyPI side: existence of other active API tokens and validity of the token written at .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md:13 (value not copied, not tested).
Git history not consulted: how long the token has been in the history and whether a purge is needed are not established.
No test or workflow run; uv run ruff check . probably lints .claude/ (no exclusion in ruff.toml), not confirmed.
.harness/audit.json absent: first audit, no comparison; the JSON was not written into the repository (instruction to change nothing).
CHANGELOG.md:9 (## 1.4.0 empty) read as the trace of the incident cited at AGENTS.md:20, an unconfirmed assumption.
